sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Artificial intelligence in medicine》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Introduction · abstract-1-1】Artificial intelligence is a branch of computer science capable of analysing complex medical data. Their potential to exploit meaningful relationship with in a data set can be used in the diagnosis, treatment and predicting outcome in many clinical scenarios.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Artificial intelligence in medicine》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Methods · abstract-2-1】Medline and internet searches were carried out using the keywords 'artificial intelligence' and 'neural networks (computer)'. Further references were obtained by cross-referencing from key articles. An overview of different artificial intelligent techniques is presented in this paper along with the review of important clinical applications.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Artificial intelligence in medicine》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Results · abstract-3-1】The proficiency of artificial intelligent techniques has been explored in almost every field of medicine. Artificial neural network was the most commonly used analytical tool whilst other artificial intelligent techniques such as fuzzy expert systems, evolutionary computation and hybrid intelligent systems have all been used in different clinical settings.

【Discussion · abstract-4-1】Artificial intelligence techniques have the potential to be applied in almost every field of medicine. There is need for further clinical trials which are appropriately designed before these emergent techniques find application in the real clinical setting.
